carpet.rule.basaltToBlackstoneConversion: Basalt that touches both lava and water at the same time converts to blackstone.
Pour potions into empty cauldrons and dip arrows to create tipped arrows, just like in Bedrock Edition. One potion bottle = 16 arrows.
carpet.rule.blastFurnaceGlass.desc: Blast furnaces can smelt sand and red sand into glass. Vanilla only allows smelting these in a furnace.
carpet.rule.blastFurnaceGlass.name: Blast Furnace Glass
carpet.rule.blastFurnaceGlazedTerracotta: Blast furnaces can smelt all 16 colors of terracotta into the glazed terracotta of the same color. Vanilla only allows smelting these in a furnace.
carpet.rule.blastFurnaceNetherBrick.desc: Blast furnaces can smelt netherrack into nether brick. Vanilla only allows smelting netherrack in a furnace.
carpet.rule.blastFurnaceNetherBrick.name: Blast Furnace Nether Brick
carpet.rule.blastFurnaceSmoothQuartz.des: Blast furnaces can smelt quartz blocks into smooth quartz. Vanilla only allows smelting quartz blocks in a furnace.
carpet.rule.blastFurnaceSmoothStone.desc: Blast furnaces can smelt stone into smooth stone. Vanilla only allows smelting stone in a furnace.
carpet.rule.blastFurnaceSmoothStone.name: Blast Furnace Smooth Stone
carpet.rule.blastFurnaceStone.desc: Blast furnaces can smelt cobblestone into stone. Vanilla only allows smelting cobblestone in a furnace.
carpet.rule.blastFurnaceStone.name: Blast Furnace Stone
Right-click nether wart with blaze powder to advance one growth stage. Vanilla bonemeal does not work on nether wart.
carpet.rule.blazeStickBlastFurnaceXp.des: While holding a blaze rod, right-clicking a blast furnace does not open its GUI; instead it clears all accumulated blast furnace experience and spawns the XP orbs at the player's position. Requires the Blaze Stick Debug rule.
carpet.rule.blazeStickDebug.desc: Activates the special functions of the blaze rod; related blaze stick rules require this rule to be enabled.
carpet.rule.blazeStickDebug.name: Blaze Stick Debug
carpet.rule.blazeStickFurnaceXp.desc: While holding a blaze rod, right-clicking a furnace does not open its GUI; instead it clears all accumulated furnace experience and spawns the XP orbs at the player's position. Requires the Blaze Stick Debug rule.
carpet.rule.blazeStickFurnaceXp.name: Blaze Stick Furnace XP
carpet.rule.blazeStickSmokerXp.desc: While holding a blaze rod, right-clicking a smoker does not open its GUI; instead it clears all accumulated smoker experience and spawns the XP orbs at the player's position. Requires the Blaze Stick Debug rule.
carpet.rule.blazeStickSmokerXp.name: Blaze Stick Smoker XP
carpet.rule.boneToBoneBlock.desc: Adds a crafting recipe for bone blocks from 3 bones (shapeless). Vanilla requires 9 bone meal instead.
carpet.rule.boneToBoneBlock.name: Craftable Bone Block
carpet.rule.bonemealGourdFruit.desc: Chance that bonemealing a mature melon or pumpkin stem grows a fruit on an adjacent block. 0 disables the feature; 1 means always fruiting.
carpet.rule.bonemealGourdFruit.name: Bonemeal Gourd Fruit
carpet.rule.brewableOminousPotion.desc: Brew awkward potion with a totem of undying for Ominous Potion I; upgrade with glowstone dust up to level V. Duration stays 1h40m (Bad Omen), same as vanilla.
carpet.rule.brewableOminousPotion.name: Brewable Ominous Potion
carpet.rule.cheapAnvilRename.desc: Renaming an item in the anvil always costs only 1 experience level, and cannot be blocked by 'Too Expensive'.
carpet.rule.cheapAnvilRename.name: Cheap Anvil Rename
carpet.rule.commandMods.desc: Enables the /mods command that lists all installed mods on the server. Takes effect immediately.
carpet.rule.commandMods.name: Command Mods
carpet.rule.constantHighEnderDragonXp.de: Killing the ender dragon always drops the first-kill experience amount (12000) instead of the reduced 500 on repeat kills.
carpet.rule.copperUnderwaterOxidationMul: Multiplier for copper oxidation speed when a copper block is in contact with water (a water source, flowing water, or a waterlogged block on any adjacent face). 1.0 is the vanilla rate; values above 1 speed it up, below 1 slow it down. Vanilla oxidation is not affected by water.
carpet.rule.craftableBell.desc: Adds a crafting recipe for the bell.
carpet.rule.craftableBell.name: Craftable Bell
carpet.rule.craftableBlueIce.desc: Adds a crafting recipe for blue ice from 8 ice and 1 blue dye (standard dyeing pattern).
carpet.rule.craftableBlueIce.name: Craftable Blue Ice
carpet.rule.craftableCobwebs.desc: Adds a crafting recipe for cobwebs from 9 string, the reverse of the old Bedrock cobweb-to-string recipe.
carpet.rule.craftableCobwebs.name: Craftable Cobwebs
carpet.rule.craftableHorseArmor.desc: Adds crafting recipes for iron, golden and diamond horse armor using the 1.6-era pattern (6 ingots/gems + 1 wool). Leather horse armor already has a vanilla recipe.
carpet.rule.craftableHorseArmor.name: Craftable Horse Armor
carpet.rule.craftableNameTag.desc: Adds a crafting recipe for the name tag.
carpet.rule.craftableNameTag.name: Craftable Name Tag
carpet.rule.craftableSaddle.desc: Adds a crafting recipe for the saddle.
carpet.rule.craftableSaddle.name: Craftable Saddle
carpet.rule.craftableStringFromWool.desc: Adds a crafting recipe to convert wool back into string (1 wool = 4 string).
carpet.rule.craftableStringFromWool.name: Craftable String From Wool
carpet.rule.dispenserGourdFruit.desc: Dispensers facing a mature melon or pumpkin stem use bone meal on it, growing a fruit with the Bonemeal Gourd Fruit chance. Requires the Bonemeal Gourd Fruit rule.
carpet.rule.dispenserGourdFruit.name: Dispenser Gourd Fruit
carpet.rule.dispenserNetherWartGrowth.de: Dispensers facing nether wart fertilize it with blaze powder, advancing one growth stage per use. Requires the Blaze Powder Nether Wart Growth rule.
carpet.rule.dispenserPlanting.desc: Dispensers shoot wheat, beetroot, carrot and potato seeds in a straight line; seeds turn into crop sprouts when hitting farmland.
carpet.rule.dispenserPlanting.name: Dispenser Planting
carpet.rule.dispenserPlantingGourds.desc: Dispensers shoot melon and pumpkin seeds in a straight line; seeds turn into stems when hitting farmland.
carpet.rule.dispenserPlantingGourds.name: Dispenser Planting Gourds
Dispensers shoot nether wart in a straight line; it sprouts when hitting soul sand.
carpet.rule.dropperAndBowToDispenser.des: Adds a crafting recipe for a dispenser from 1 dropper and 1 bow (shapeless). Vanilla requires 7 cobblestone, 1 bow and 1 redstone.
carpet.rule.durableAnvil.desc: Using the anvil (repair, enchant, rename) no longer damages it; the anvil can still be broken physically.
carpet.rule.durableAnvil.name: Durable Anvil
carpet.rule.durableFallingAnvil.desc: Falling anvils no longer get damaged when they hit the ground; they can still be broken physically.
carpet.rule.durableFallingAnvil.name: Durable Falling Anvil
carpet.rule.endCrystalPlacementRestricti: End crystals can only be placed on obsidian or bedrock (vanilla behavior, enabled by default). When disabled, they can be placed on any block.
carpet.rule.evokerDeathKillsVexes.desc: Vexes summoned by an evoker die immediately when the evoker dies.
carpet.rule.evokerDeathKillsVexes.name: Evoker Death Kills Vexes
carpet.rule.featherFallingProtectsFarmla: Landing on farmland while wearing boots with Feather Falling no longer turns it into dirt.
carpet.rule.grindstoneRemovesCurses.desc: Cursed enchantments (binding curse, vanishing curse) can be removed with a grindstone.
carpet.rule.grindstoneRemovesCurses.name: Grindstone Removes Curses
carpet.rule.legacyEnchantedGoldenApple.d: Restores the pre-1.9 enchanted golden apple Regeneration V (30s) effect, replacing Regeneration II (20s). Other effects stay as in the new version.
carpet.rule.neutralPiglins.desc: Piglins no longer proactively attack players who are not wearing gold armor, but the pack-aggression mechanic (e.g. after you attack a piglin or a piglin brute) still works as vanilla.
carpet.rule.neutralPiglins.name: Neutral Piglins
carpet.rule.piglinBarterDisabledTime.des: Sets how long (in ticks) a piglin refuses to barter after being hit by a player. Vanilla is 400 ticks (20 seconds); 0 disables the refusal.
carpet.rule.quartzBlockToQuartz.desc: Adds a crafting recipe to convert a quartz block back into 4 quartz, the reverse of the vanilla 2x2 recipe.
carpet.rule.quartzBlockToQuartz.name: Quartz Block to Quartz
carpet.rule.reinforcedObsidian.desc: Obsidian becomes immune to the Wither's block-breaking burst (the one it emits after taking damage); the Wither can no longer destroy obsidian. Regular explosions already cannot break obsidian.
carpet.rule.reinforcedObsidian.name: Reinforced Obsidian
carpet.rule.removeAnvilTooExpensive.desc: Anvil operations (repair, enchant, rename) no longer become 'Too Expensive' when the cost reaches 40 levels; they remain available.
carpet.rule.removeAnvilTooExpensive.name: Remove Anvil Too Expensive
carpet.rule.shapelessCraftingBread.desc: Allows crafting bread from 3 wheat in any arrangement, instead of the vanilla horizontal row.
carpet.rule.shapelessCraftingBread.name: Shapeless Bread
carpet.rule.shapelessCraftingPaper.desc: Allows crafting 3 paper from 3 sugar cane in any arrangement, instead of the vanilla vertical column.
carpet.rule.shapelessCraftingPaper.name: Shapeless Paper
Allows crafting a shulker box from 1 chest and 2 shulker shells in any arrangement, instead of the vanilla vertical column.
carpet.rule.shortenedTrialSpawnerCooldow: Shortens the trial spawner cooldown to 5 minutes (instead of the vanilla 30 minutes).
carpet.rule.shovelSnowLayer.desc: Right-clicking a snow layer with a shovel removes one layer.
carpet.rule.shovelSnowLayer.name: Shovel Snow Layer
Shoveling a snow layer drops one snowball per removed layer. Requires shovelSnowLayer.
carpet.rule.silkTouchBuddingAmethyst.des: Allows collecting budding amethyst blocks with a Silk Touch tool.
carpet.rule.silkTouchFarmland.desc: Mining farmland with a Silk Touch tool drops the farmland block itself instead of dirt.
carpet.rule.silkTouchFarmland.name: Silk Touch Farmland
carpet.rule.silkTouchPathBlocks.desc: Mining a dirt path with a Silk Touch tool drops the path block itself instead of dirt.
carpet.rule.silkTouchPathBlocks.name: Silk Touch Path Blocks
carpet.rule.silkTouchSpawners.desc: Mining a monster spawner with a Silk Touch tool drops the spawner itself, preserving its spawn configuration (entity type and spawn potentials).
carpet.rule.silkTouchSpawners.name: Silk Touch Spawners
carpet.rule.silkTouchSuspiciousBlocks.de: Allows collecting suspicious sand and gravel with a Silk Touch tool.
carpet.rule.smokerGreenDye.desc: Smokers can smelt cactus into green dye. Vanilla only allows smelting cactus in a furnace.
carpet.rule.smokerGreenDye.name: Smoker Green Dye
carpet.rule.snowGolemNoMelt.desc: Snow golems no longer take melting damage in hot biomes (deserts, the nether, badlands, etc.).
carpet.rule.snowGolemNoMelt.name: Snow Golem No Melt
carpet.rule.splashOxidizeCopper.desc: Throwing a splash water bottle at a copper block instantly oxidizes it to the next stage.
carpet.rule.splashOxidizeCopper.name: Splash Oxidize Copper
carpet.rule.stackableProtection.desc: Different protection enchantments (protection, blast protection, fire protection, projectile protection) can be applied to the same piece of armor and stack.
carpet.rule.stackableProtection.name: Stackable Protection
carpet.rule.stopCreeperGriefing.desc: Creeper explosions no longer destroy blocks; they still deal damage and knockback.
carpet.rule.stopCreeperGriefing.name: Stop Creeper Griefing
carpet.rule.stopEndCrystalGriefing.desc: End crystal explosions no longer destroy blocks; they still deal damage.
carpet.rule.stopEndCrystalGriefing.name: Stop End Crystal Griefing
carpet.rule.stopGhastGriefing.desc: Ghast fireball explosions no longer destroy blocks; they still deal damage.
carpet.rule.stopGhastGriefing.name: Stop Ghast Griefing
carpet.rule.tadpoleDyeColor.desc: Feeding a tadpole one of the three dyes (orange/white/green) marks the color of the frog it grows into. Each tadpole can be dyed only once; growth is not sped up.
carpet.rule.tadpoleDyeColor.name: Tadpole Dye Color
carpet.rule.villagerBedExplosion.desc: Villagers using a bed in the nether or the end cause it to explode, like players do.
carpet.rule.villagerBedExplosion.name: Villager Bed Explosion
carpet.rule.villagerLightningNoWitch.des: Villagers struck by lightning no longer turn into witches.
carpet.rule.woodToChest.desc: Adds a crafting recipe for a chest from 2 of any log (shapeless). Vanilla requires 8 planks instead.
carpet.rule.woodToChest.name: Craftable Chest
